note: TVA campground on Watts Bar Lake run by the concessionaire Tennessee Valley Hospitality (Go Camp Tennessee): gravel sites under tall scattered trees along the shore and around a loop on the point, with a boat ramp, a roped-off swimming beach and a pavilion. --Claude
summary: Fooshee Pass (Go Camp Tennessee, TVA): operator confirms 54 sites, all water + 30 A, showers, dump; 28 RV sites book online on Campspot (22 sold as 'Waterfront'); October 2026 $40-47 + $10 reservation surcharge stands (2027 not open); season 03-15..11-14 stands; Google 4.6 (217). Waterfront: stored 'not waterfront' looks too low - flagged as at least lakeview, lakefront candidate, site numbers unreadable.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored 'not waterfront' looks too low; reviewer to decide): Campspot sells 22 RV sites as 'Waterfront' by the night (2-night online minimum). The Campspot park map puts a row of sites along the shore and a loop on the point. The stored evidence ('loop set back behind treeline', read at 35.6605,-84.756) looked about 450 m south of the campground. On NAIP summer imagery the point loop (~35.66464,-84.75734) sits under tall trees with summer water on three sides; 3DEP puts its centre at 227.7 m and its edges at 225.2-225.3 m, against Watts Bar's 741-ft (225.9 m) summer pool, so the outer pads are ~1-2 m above the water and ~10-25 m from it. The shore-side row pads (~35.66463,-84.75830 to 35.66400,-84.75900) sit 229.7-234.9 m, 4-9 m above pool, ~25-40 m back. The operator's photos show gravel pads on mown grass under scattered tall trunks, with the lake visible beyond; that open view puts the floor at lakeview. Lakefront for the point loop is plausible, but no site numbers could be read (2027 inventory not open; the map is unlabelled), so no upgrade past lakeview is supported.

PRIVATE CHECKS: Google 4.6 (217 reviews); presence: operator site + phone 865-361-1233; price under the gate ($40-47 base). Long-stay: 28 of 54 sites book online; the rules mention long-term sites and a 21-day limit otherwise - about half nightly, not mostly seasonal.
SEASON: the operator page still shows the 2025 season (March 15 - November 15); Campspot's closed dates 2026-11-15 to 2027-03-14 back the stored 03-15..11-14.

WEBSITE: Campspot names the marketing site as camprrm.com/parks/tennessee/tva-easements/fooshee-pass-campground/, and Google lists none; gocamptennessee.com is live and current, so the stored website stays.
